description:
Keep a clear record of the hours you put into your rental properties, all year long.

LandlordHours finds the hours in your calendar, turns a quick note into a finished entry, and keeps every property in one place. Each confirmed hour adds to the house on your Today screen, so you can see the year take shape.

HOURS THAT FIND YOU
• Your calendar suggests the site visits, calls and meetings you already had. Confirm them in a tap.
• Write a plain-English note and AI fills in the property, category, hours and date.
• Run a timer while you work, or add time later.

SEE WHERE YOU STAND
• Follow the 750-hour and 500-hour goals, the 100-hour goal, and the more-than-half test, all on one screen.
• Keep spouse hours apart, the way the rules treat them.
• Every rental at a glance: hours, goal and recent work.
• Short-term and long-term rentals side by side.

A RECORD YOU CAN HAND OVER
• Attach photos, receipts and notes to any entry.
• Export a clean PDF report for your CPA.

YOUR WIDGET IS BACK
A redesigned Home Screen widget shows your house and your hours without opening the app.

PRIVATE BY DESIGN
• AI note-reading runs on your iPhone. Your notes do not leave your phone.
• Back up through your own iCloud account.

LandlordHours is a recordkeeping tool. It does not give tax, legal or financial advice, and it cannot tell you whether you qualify for any tax status. Talk to a licensed tax professional about your own situation.
promotionalText: Your calendar finds the hours you worked. Confirm them in a tap and watch your house go up. Plain records you can hand to your CPA.
